method.loop: Research -> Pattern Hypothesis -> Human Draft -> Slop Audit -> Rewrite -> Output
method.rejected_generic_version: Love is when your partner listens to your problems and makes you feel emotionally safe.
method.why_rejected: It explains the feeling like a therapy page and gives no private-send reason. Nobody tags their person because a carousel says listening matters.
method.human_rewrite_direction: Make the first slide sound like something one person wishes their partner would say first.

premise_lock.human_situation: One partner wants permission to be ordinary, annoying, emotional, talkative, needy, or boring without becoming a burden.
premise_lock.speaker: Usually the partner who is afraid they are too much, with Aachu/Zuv making the feeling visible through a private scene.
premise_lock.receiver: The person they would send it to because it says the thing they cannot text first.
premise_lock.emotional_job: Trigger 'babe this is us', 'why is this you', 'I needed you to say this', or 'guilty' within three seconds.
must_not_move_away_from: owned winners ranked by shares per 1k reach
Aachu and Zuv as a specific couple, not generic romantic figures
quiet scene proof before quote-card polish
hard_rejects: mean call-out that would start a fight

pattern_hypothesis.what_travels: A direct line that gives one partner permission to send a vulnerable need without typing it themselves.
pattern_hypothesis.best_mechanic: Soft command or soft accusation on slide 1, then 3-4 concrete receipts that make the other partner feel seen.
pattern_hypothesis.kabir_read: The strongest next carousel should not say 'you are safe with me'. It should say the thing a safe person would actually say.

novelty_model.new_reveal: The loving thing is not advice. It is wanting the long, repetitive, messy version.

top_pick.title: please vent to me more
top_pick.why_it_wins: It has the cleanest send decision. The viewer who feels annoying can send it to ask for permission without asking. The receiver can send it back as reassurance without writing a speech.
top_pick.scene_landing_reason: The first frame stops because it is a request, not a lesson. The payoff 'say the rest' turns the source's venting permission into a concrete Aachu/Zuv relationship moment.
top_pick.runner_up_reason: Care phrases will bait comments well, but the first-slide line is less vulnerable than 'please vent to me more.'

engagement_rationale.three_second_hook: The top pick lands in three words plus one private wound: venting. It is easy to read, easy to send, and not visually complicated.
engagement_rationale.send_trigger: The sender does not have to say 'please listen to me even when I repeat myself'. The post says it.
engagement_rationale.tag_trigger: The listener can be tagged as the person who says 'say the rest', which is affectionate status, not a mean call-out.
engagement_rationale.comment_trigger: People will confess their own rant-apology habit or tag the person who listens. That is warmer than debate bait.
engagement_rationale.save_trigger: Candidates 02, 03, and 05 are save-friendly because they name ordinary care and private details people want to keep.

distribution_risks.mitigation: Keep all visible copy plain: 'please vent to me more', 'sorry, too much', 'say the rest'. Do not use 'hold space', 'safe person', or 'emotional availability'.

distribution_risks.mitigation: Use only if the room wants owned-performance safety over freshness, and keep the new reveal narrowed to the 'nothing happened' face.
